title: GLM-5V-Turbo: Toward a Native Foundation Model for Multimodal Agents
task: Building native multimodal foundation models for agentic tasks

title: Enhanced Privacy and Communication Efficiency in Non-IID Federated Learning with Adaptive Quantization and Differential Privacy

comments: Laplacian DP offers tighter bounds than Gaussian but is underexplored in FL; client-based bit-length scheduler (entropy-driven) outperforms global scheduler and avoids overhead of per-sample DP noise.

hypotheses.result: Confirmed: systematic data reduction across all three datasets

hypotheses.hypothesis: Client-based scheduler using dataset entropy adapts better than global scheduler

hypotheses.hypothesis: Laplacian DP preserves privacy with tighter guarantees than Gaussian DP
hypotheses.result: Assumed (underexplored in FL literature); empirical privacy-utility trade-offs demonstrated across ε values
